difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for locally Noetherian algebraic spaces X and Y over a scheme S and a smooth morphism f : X -> Y, one has dim_x(X) = dim_y(Y) + dim_x(X_y) at every point x with image y, where the last term is the relative dimension of f at x (source lines 7536-7546). The proof unwinds the definition of the dimension of an algebraic space at a point and reduces the statement to the corresponding statement for schemes.
